state_model.primitive: generic authored event with exact predicate, durable local commit, projections, recovery, and replay
projection_order: commit local idempotency key and canonical payload

automation.A2: director approval required; never inferred or auto-promoted

projection_runtime.local_file_ledger: atomic lock/write, exclusive expiring leases, stale-token rejection, five-second-to-five-minute bounded exponential backoff, eight-attempt ceiling, restart readback
projection_runtime.supabase_proposal: service-role-only claim/complete RPCs use FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, exact lease tokens, due-time retry and a reversible 0018 migration; no production SQL was applied
projection_runtime.discord_delivery: 28 exact authored readbacks are delivered without player payloads; stable 25-character nonce plus enforce_nonce protects the post-before-ack crash window
projection_runtime.unknown_event_behavior: fail closed and retain the projection error; never improvise player-facing canon

surface_contracts.minecraft: places, systems, physical custody, changed-space consequence, and protected actions; never the sole puzzle app
surface_contracts.copperline: immutable lived-in account/community history plus append-only earned replies, restored revisions, and cache-safe readback; never a clue menu
surface_contracts.discord: player investigation, theories, dissent, character contact, and exact authored reaction; the implemented event worker is a consequence projector, never an answer judge or payload echo
surface_contracts.dashboard_web: director health, exact A1 trigger visibility, approvals, replay, accessibility, and rollback; never player-facing omniscient exposition
surface_contracts.media_files: hash-bound fragments, version/provenance work, and accessible equivalents; missing bytes remain fail-closed
surface_contracts.npc_watcher: relationship-bound preauthored responses and consequences; no generative canon, forced voice, or hidden receipt quota

failure_and_recovery.projection_outage: canonical local event remains committed; failed surface projection waits for its durable bounded backoff, is reclaimed only by an expiring lease, and catch-up exposes the same authored consequence
failure_and_recovery.restart: reload canonical events before projecting changed state; never infer completion from decoration or observation history
failure_and_recovery.wrong_action: preserve theory/attempt and return authored non-spoiler response; do not create progress or consume evidence
failure_and_recovery.late_or_absent_player: read-only case-so-far plus accessible source paths and contributed player artifacts; no required named participant
failure_and_recovery.rollback: surface projections may roll back to the last canonical event; irreversible production/public mutation is outside this offline authority
